svg.text: Grain free amino acid GWAS (71 traits)
Free pool dominated by Asn and Pro
Free AA and Pro up, Asp and Glu down
QTL mapping of free Asp and Pro
Candidate genes on aspartate and glutamate metabolism
Genes are positional candidates: within 25 kb of a significant GWAS SNP, or in a top-5% FST window. Numbers are Zm00001eb gene IDs (B73 RefGen_v5).
Shaded box: L-homoserine biosynthesis, the only CornCyc pathway with a candidate gene in all four analyses (permutation P = 0.0012; not significant after correction for 468 pathways).
Thick arrows, steps of L-homoserine biosynthesis. Dashed arrows, amide-N donation from Gln to Asn synthesis, and Asn transamination with ω-amidase returning carbon to oxaloacetate.
